task_name: Add client attachment API, SSE refresh, and activity descriptions

strengths: FormData upload/create omit Content-Type so the browser can set the multipart boundary; JSON create without attachments still sends application/json
Attachment SSE is additive: attachment.* shares the existing card-event registry and scheduleRefresh path; tracker, membership, agent, and focus branches are unchanged
Activity copy is explicit plain text on card and workspace surfaces; TYPE_META stays label/badge metadata with no thumbnail markup or image bytes
Tests drive the stated boundaries: exported api methods via mocked fetch, rendered BoardProvider via EventSource, and exported describeCardEvent/describeEvent without mocking those functions
No tracker/unified mutation path, no public /uploads URLs, no second polling loop, and no T10/T12/T13 picker-gallery-cover UI

issues.description: Attachment API tests assert CSRF and a null Content-Type but never assert credentials: "include", so they would still pass if the shared request() credentials line were removed. GWT asked for credentials through the shared request boundary; production code sets it on request().

Board-create field lists are duplicated between serializeBoardCreateMetadata (multipart) and the JSON createCard branch. A later payload field can drift on one path only (2 copies, under the 3+ refactor heuristic).
